collection.title: Maserati Gran Turismo 2007 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Maserati Gran Turismo 2007 - 2017 model requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers side and a 17" wiper blade for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
